body:
Hi, we're buying new handheld scanners for the Bergen warehouse. Which firmware versions does your app support?

Elena Petrova
Warehouse Systems, Fjord Outfitters
Hi Elena, any Zebra or Honeywell scanner on firmware 8.2 or later works with the current app.

Since Monday none of our patients are getting SMS appointment reminders.

Elena Park
Practice Manager, Parkside Clinics

Please add our new warehouse in Stavanger as a stock location.

Lars Holm
Logistics, Fjord Outfitters
Hi Lars, happy to. Could you send the street address and the opening date?

Our billing address changed to Strandkaien 12, 5013 Bergen. Please update it for future invoices.

Elena Petrova
Warehouse Systems, Fjord Outfitters
Done, Elena. The next invoice will use the new address.
